comments.author: @Ealdorman_of_Mercia
comments.text: I came on this tv show completely by accident.. I was looking for that other show called 1899 the sci fi thing, and came across this. Why is this not being promoted? Apparently lots of people in the comment section loved it.

comments.author: @jwonderfulsuccess
comments.text: This was the best series I've ever seen in my life. Absolutely incredible story, filmography and acting. 11/10. The last episode had me shedding tears throughout the whole episode, and I'm a pretty "tough guy". Isabel May is an amazing talented and beautiful person. Much gratitude to everyone that made this series happen. Im counting down the days to start watching the next series about the Dutton family and also the Bass Reeves series!!! 🥰🙏

comments.author: @bushido56
comments.text: On episode 3 now. One of the best shows ever made. Feels like a robbery watching this on a streaming service and not the cinema. Wow what a masterpiece. From the intro and music to Elsas story telling voice, it is all giving me the shivers.

comments.author: @petermueller7407
comments.text: It broke our hearts. Really. It is such an extremely well made series, so that we absolutely identified with the family. The ending we did not expect. We were shocked and traumatized. I mean that. Certainly never have felt something like that before watching a TV series.

comments.author: @Robman92
comments.text: Sam Elliot was perfectly cast for this! He always looks like a cowboy stuck in modern times, this show is his home 🙌
